Results.ReviewText: Great 3 burner grill. We had a 2 burner and this is way hotter.
Results.Title: Feel the burn

Results.ReviewText:
Easy-to-follow assembly directions; all the parts were there - one of the flanges where the front panel (covering the knob stems) meets the grill frame was bent back a bit and had to be straightened to 'meet' the matching screw holes - but that was easily remedied with a pair of pliers.  The grill is amazing - evenly heats the grates, temperature is actually adjustable, and clean-up with a Weber wired grill brush is easy.
Very satisfied.
Results.Title: Very satisfied.

Results.ReviewText: This is the first time owning a Weber grill, and I’m so happy I finally bought one.  So far, I’m very pleased with my grill.
Results.Title: First time Weber grill owner.

Results.ReviewText:
Assembled and delivered right to my house. Starts with just a press of a button.
Our steaks came out perfect, great grill.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: So practical and quick to cook with! Perfect size! We love it!

Results.ReviewText: This grill cooks much better than my previous grill. Love the reversible grates - one side is great for burgers, the other side is great for chicken. (Have not tried a steak yet, but assume it will be very good.) Heats evenly and much more quickly than my previous grill. Large cooking space. And the appearance of the grill is great too!
Results.Title: Weber E-310 is a great grill

Results.ReviewText: Heats up quick and even across three burners. Solid build and cover. Awesome product and even better customer service. Thank you Weber!!!
Results.Title: Spirit E-310

Results.ReviewText: I grill 2 or 3 times a week this grill is perfect for my family. This new weber replaces my 20 year old weber that still had original burners and lighter still worked
Results.Title: Weber grills last along time

Results.ReviewText: It is very simple to use and it is so handy because it connects to my phone. Fantastic!
Results.Title: Buy one now

Results.ReviewText: It cooks perfect every time. The grill guide app. Is very helpful in deciding how long to cook the food. My biggest regret is that I didn’t buy it sooner.
Results.Title: Spirit  Grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy and fast set up. Food tasted great even with first grill.
Results.Title: Awesome grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: Use it twice and it works fine. I purchased it for the quality.
Results.Title: Good quality

Results.ReviewText: It's like having an outdoor kitchen stove with this grill. Highly recommend it
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText:
I am loving my new grill.
I would like to thank the customer support group. I had a problem with my grill that occurred when loading the already assembled grill into the back of my Tahoe. I contacted support to find out where I could get parts to fix it. Through excellent communication,  they sent the parts for me to replace..free of charge. I am such a happy customer and intend to let everyone I know, all about it.
Results.Title: Great customer support

Results.ReviewText: The grill is fantastic! Gets hot quick, cooks evenly and has hooks on both side trays for my tools. The app has great recipes as well as a guide for cooking times.  The casters offer a smooth and easy roll. The gas gauge lets me know when I need to replace my tank and the exterior door keeps it all covered and looking nice. Assembly was easy, put it together by myself in about 90 minutes. I want to use it everyday!
Results.Title: Do it! Do it now!

Results.ReviewText: Solid overall construction and pleasing appearance

The spirit E-310 is the perfect addition to our deck. 
along with our smoker, I now have the capability to cook all types of food.

Results.ReviewText: Grill is fine, except rotisserie cooking is a large part of what we use a grill for, and this grill could be better designed for this task. Rotisserie slots are too small for standard rotisserie spits and mounted too low to allow larger items to be mounted.

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size grill for my husband and I.  I have wanted a Weber FOREVER!!!   I am hopeful this will be the last grill we ever buy.  The only hitch was delivery coordination and once I outreached to Weber that was resolved within 24-hours.

Results.ReviewText: I have been using Weber grills for over twenty years and they are far superior to all others, that I have owned

Results.ReviewText: THIS IS MY 4TH WEBER AND I LOVE IT. EASY TO USE. GREAT TECH SUPPORT. ONLY THING I DONT LIKE IS THE LOCATION OF THE TANK. AT83 YEARS OF AGE IT IS EXTREMELY HARD TO PUT A NEW FULL TANK ON THAT BRACKET--SO I PUT IT ON A BOARD ON THE BOTTOM

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
